description: Structural evaluation of the research-brief skill: construct and audit modes, W1-W12 convention enforcement, and integration with the wiki/meta/research-queue.md row updates. Test cases assume the vault at ~/ai-secondbrain is in the state captured on 2026-05-27 (queue rows R-2026-001..R-2026-009 with R-2026-001/002/003 done, R-2026-004 and R-2026-006/007/008 carrying hand-written briefs without brief_version: 1, R-2026-005/009 still _to brief_).

evals.name: construct-dach-task-from-queue
evals.prompt: schreib mir den Brief für R-2026-005
evals.expected_output: A new brief file at wiki/meta/brief-R-2026-005-<slug>.md carrying brief_version: 1, all twelve convention sections present and passing, and the research-queue.md row for R-2026-005 updated (Brief column points to the new wikilink, Updated column = today). Because R-2026-005 has program: VAL (DACH-flavored), the W6 hard gate fires and the brief includes an explicit ≥30% German-language primary-source quota. The skill must surface the Phase-1 frame-check question to the user before composing (Auto Mode is intentionally overridden in this phase).

assertions.text: Phase-1 frame-check question surfaced to user before any file is written
Exactly one new file created under wiki/meta/ matching brief-R-2026-005-*.md
Brief frontmatter contains brief_version: 1
Brief frontmatter contains conventions_applied listing W1-W12
Brief body contains a Meta-question section with all four sub-elements (Assumed framing, Alternative framings considered, Why the chosen framing won, Tripwire)
Every numbered Research objective ends with a Falsification sub-bullet (W3)
Brief body contains a Phase 0 -- Scout section with explicit time/token bound and exit conditions (W8)
Stopping condition contains both a Must-have block and a Best-effort block, with the best-effort block including the explicit Evidence-Gap fallback (W4)
Stopping condition contains an explicit German-language source quota of at least 30% (W6 hard gate, program: VAL)
Every Deliverables path begins with wiki/meta/draft-R-2026-005/ (W11)
Any deliverable under a decisions/ subpath starts with Decision-Brief- (not Decision-) and the brief instructs the loop to set decision_status: pending_human_review (W5)
Source classes use the tier vocabulary (Primary / Expert-secondary / Practitioner) with per-tier numeric minimums (W7)
Cost-ceiling justification names sub-topic count, citation intensity, and time-sensitivity (W9)
Brief contains an Exemplar: line followed by either a wikilink or the explicit TBD declaration (W10)
research-queue.md row for R-2026-005 updated: Brief cell replaced from _to brief_ with a wikilink to the new brief; Updated column = today (YYYY-MM-DD)
research-queue.md was the only file in wiki/meta/ that the skill modified beyond the new brief file

evals.name: audit-handwritten-brief-fails-hard-gates
evals.expected_output: The skill reads wiki/meta/brief-R-2026-004-vertical-scoring.md and produces a section-by-section audit table covering W1-W12. Because this brief was hand-written before the skill existed and does not carry brief_version: 1, the audit must identify the hard-gate failures: no Meta-question section (W12), no Falsification sub-bullets per objective (W3), no Phase 0 -- Scout section (W8), no two-tier stopping condition with Evidence-Gap fallback (W4), deliverables not in wiki/meta/draft-R-2026-004/ paths (W11), and a Decision-* file rather than Decision-Brief-* (W5). The skill must NOT silently mark the brief as brief_version: 1. It should offer to apply the suggested edits in-place.

assertions.text: No new file is created (audit mode reads only)
Audit table produced with one row per W1-W12 convention, each row carrying Section, Status (pass/warn/**fail**), and Note columns
W3 audit row reports fail with concrete count of objectives missing Falsification sub-bullets
W4 audit row reports fail (no Must-have / Best-effort split with Evidence-Gap fallback)
W5 audit row reports fail (deliverable Vertical-1-Pick-DACH-2026.md is a Decision- rather than Decision-Brief-)
W8 audit row reports fail (no Phase-0 Scout section)
W11 audit row reports fail (deliverables target wiki/research/, wiki/concepts/, wiki/decisions/ etc., not wiki/meta/draft-R-2026-004/)
W12 audit row reports fail (no Meta-question section)
Brief frontmatter is NOT mutated to brief_version: 1 by the audit step
The skill offers to apply the suggested edits in-place (one prompt to user)
research-queue.md is not modified during the audit-report phase

evals.name: refuse-overwrite-already-briefed-done-task
evals.prompt: schreib mir den Brief für R-2026-002
evals.expected_output: R-2026-002 is status: done and its Brief column already points to a non-_to brief_ link ([[autoresearch-prompts-2026-05-26#Prompt 2]]). The skill must refuse to overwrite, surface the existing brief path, and offer to switch to audit mode. No file is created and no queue row is modified.

assertions.text: No new brief file is created
The existing brief path is surfaced to the user verbatim
The skill offers to switch to audit mode rather than proceeding with construct
research-queue.md is not modified
The skill notes that R-2026-002 is status: done (an additional reason not to overwrite)

evals.name: construct-free-form-topic-registers-queue-row
evals.prompt: /brief AI Tax Automation für deutsche Steuerberater
evals.expected_output: No task ID was given. The skill should propose registering a new queue row first (next free R-2026-NNN, suggest program code based on topic — VERT or VAL most plausible — and ask user to confirm program + priority). Only after user confirms, the skill appends the queue row, then runs the construct workflow. Because the topic is DACH-flavored ('deutsche Steuerberater'), W6 fires and the DE-source quota is required.

assertions.text: Skill asks for program and priority before any write
Skill proposes the next free R-2026-NNN task ID rather than guessing
Skill only writes to research-queue.md after user confirmation of program/priority
If confirmed, a new queued row appears in research-queue.md with the proposed task ID
Brief file is then created at wiki/meta/brief-R-2026-NNN-<slug>.md with brief_version: 1
Brief stopping condition contains the ≥30% German-language quota (W6, DACH topic by language signal)
Phase-1 frame-check question is surfaced before composing the brief
